controls_used.control: A pelican riding a bicycle. Click the pe

notes.b1/j1/F-r1: Clear pelican with big pouch seated on a detailed bike with chain, spinning spoked wheels and scrolling road; pause, cadence and honk all work, though the wing and body overlap the frame a little awkwardly.
notes.b1/j1/Q-r1: Simple, readable pelican on a bike with parallax hills and clouds and working pause and speed, but the neck and frame are crude and the pelican is a bit generic.
notes.b1/j1/A-r1: Pleasant scene with a bell, DING text and distance readout, but the pelican floats above a thin frame, the wheels are faint, and the wing arm is pale and plain.
notes.b1/j1/Q-r2: Recognisable pelican on a teal bike with scrolling scenery and pedals, but the grey triangular wing is odd, the legs read thinly and the frame geometry is off.
notes.b1/j1/A-r2: Dark-themed page with a fun helmeted pelican, reverse, honk and distance readout; the pelican and bike are clean but the wing is a flat slab and the legs are thin.
notes.b1/j1/F-r2: Most polished build with a cargo crate, chain, eased start and stop, reverse, bell with sound, a status line and 44px controls; the pelican is small, and the crate and loaf and fish are an addition beyond the request.
notes.b1/j2/Q-r2: Clear pelican with pouch, pedalling legs and scrolling scenery plus pause, speed and honk, though the honk has little visible effect and the pose is a bit stiff.
notes.b1/j2/A-r2: Large, charming pelican in a helmet with a wing on the handlebar, smooth pedalling, reverse, distance and honk counters and a HONK text on click.
notes.b1/j2/F-r2: Most polished: expressive pelican, detailed chain, wheel and rack, gentle eased start and stop, audio bell, reduced-motion handling and 44px controls; the cargo bike is an embellishment.
notes.b1/j2/A-r1: Works, but the straight vertical legs look awkward, the cloud collides with the sun and the bird is simplistic.
notes.b1/j2/Q-r1: Clean outlined pelican with a swinging pouch and good pedalling, but the bird is small and the controls are minimal.
notes.b1/j2/F-r1: Detailed large bicycle with toothed chainring and a hidden click-to-honk, but the pelican reads less clearly, the road moves slowly and the honk has little feedback.
notes.b1/j3/A-r2: Readable pelican with big pouch, helmet and wing on the handlebar, working pause, speed, reverse and honk controls, though the legs and hip placement are a bit odd.
notes.b1/j3/F-r2: Most polished in craft, controls and accessibility, but it swaps in a cargo bike with a crate and the S-curved neck and wing are not on the handlebar.
notes.b1/j3/Q-r2: Clean and correct pelican on a regular bike with pause, speed and honk, but the legs and pedals look slightly tangled.
notes.b1/j3/F-r1: Large, well-drawn bike and pelican with a nice pouch and chain details, a hand-on-bar wing, and pause, cadence and click-to-honk controls.
notes.b1/j3/A-r1: Layered parallax hills, a bell and a speed readout, but the pelican's neck is faint and the legs and frame are thin.
notes.b1/j3/Q-r1: Cute outlined pelican with a clear neck and bill that reads well, a simple bike and few controls (pause, speed).
notes.b2/j1/F-r3: Large, well-outlined pelican with wing gripping the bars, IK legs, spinning spokes, visible bell with ding bubble, road-scroll toggle, good phone layout and reduced-motion handling.
notes.b2/j1/Q-r3: Clean parallax scene with trees and clouds and a charming pelican, but the bike is small, the wing does not reach the grip, and the bell gives only text feedback.
notes.b2/j1/A-r3: Helmeted pelican with wing on the bars, honk visual, live readout and keyboard shortcuts; cadence reads 0 at start and the readout text is tiny on mobile.
notes.b2/j1/Q-r4: Attractive scene with helmet and trees, but the arm is a thin stub, the bell is a checkbox whose puff effect is barely visible, and the pelican is small.
notes.b2/j1/A-r4: Many features (night mode, reverse, synth bell) but the pelican looks blobby, the legs and feet are crude, and the grey-green ground band is awkward.
notes.b2/j1/F-r4: Cute thick-outlined pelican and a visible bell, but the sky is plain, the wing hangs behind rather than gripping the bars, and the scenery is sparse.
notes.b2/j2/Q-r4: Charming helmeted pelican with a wing on the bar, clean IK legs, parallax scenery and tidy controls, though the pedal mechanics are a bit small.
notes.b2/j2/A-r4: Oversized pelican body on a thin frame with a murky grey band behind the road, but night mode, reverse, bell with sound and a readout make it feature-rich and working.
notes.b2/j2/F-r4: Clean, readable pelican on bike with a bell button, accessible controls and good phone layout, but the scenery is sparse and the rider is a little stiff.
notes.b2/j2/A-r3: Well-composed scene with helmet, blinking eye, honk, parallax hills and keyboard shortcuts; the wing and legs read clearly, though the speed slider's range is odd.
notes.b2/j2/Q-r3: Good trees and pouch detail, but hill tiles show a visible seam, the wheels are small against the large bird, and a focus box appears on the bell click.
notes.b2/j2/F-r3: Most polished: big racing bike, arm reaching the grip, S-curved neck with nod, bell with speech bubble, road-scroll toggle, reduced-motion handling and 44px touch targets.
notes.b2/j3/A-r4: Charming helmeted pelican with parallax, working pedal IK and extra night/reverse controls, but the wing just sits on the body and the bird looks a bit pasted on.
notes.b2/j3/F-r4: Clean outlined pelican with bell on the handlebar and spinning chainring, but the pale washed-out scene and wing not reaching the bars make it less lively.
notes.b2/j3/Q-r4: Polished helmeted pelican with wing arm to the grip, trees and parallax; the bell as a checkbox with a faint puff is a weak control.
notes.b2/j3/F-r3: Largest, most convincing pelican with wing arm gripping the bars, bell on the handlebar, ding bubble, sunset sky and well-labelled keyboard-friendly controls.
notes.b2/j3/A-r3: Strong helmeted pelican with blinking, honk bubble and keyboard shortcuts, though the dense monospace status line is cramped on a phone.
notes.b2/j3/Q-r3: Works and has trees and a ring message, but the pelican is small with a flat grey sheet for a wing, a salmon pouch, and a stray focus box on bell click.
